news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.36 (vs ₹1.47 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.36 (up from ₹1.47 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹333.9m (flat on 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.43m (up ₹7.34m from 3Q 2025). news.title: Inducto Steels Limited Announces Resignation of Nishant Rajeev Reniwal as Key Managerial Person, Effective December 18, 2025
news.body: Inducto Steels Limited announced that Mr. Nishant Rajeev Reniwal has tendered his resignation as Key Managerial Person of the Company vide his letter dated December 18, 2025 received and accepted by the Company on December 18, 2025, due to personal reasons. His last working day with the Company was December 18, 2025.

news.title: Inducto Steels Limited Announces Resignation of Nishant Rajeev Reniwal as Chief Financial Officer, Effective December 18, 2025
news.body: Inducto Steels Limited announced that Mr. Nishant Rajeev Reniwal has tendered his resignation as Chief Financial Officer of the Company vide his letter dated December 18, 2025 received and accepted by the Company on December 18, 2025, due to personal reasons. His last working day with the Company was December 18, 2025.
